findings.note: After Copy-Payload succeeds for all targets, a batch-wide post-copy hash failure leaves FailedTarget null and PublishedTargets containing every target. The failure report therefore labels the corrupted target INSTALLED and claims its digest was verified, without a FAILED entry, contradicting design.md Protected-File Statement point 5's requirement to truthfully enumerate installed, failed, and not-attempted targets on every post-copy-phase failure. The preceding exception names the mismatch and execution remains fail-closed, limiting severity.

The suite exercises post-copy corruption but asserts only nonzero exit and the mismatch diagnostic; it does not verify the accompanying live-state enumeration. TEST-012 covers only a failure inside Copy-Payload where FailedTarget is populated, so it cannot detect the contradictory post-copy-failure report.
